Create ONE complete full-screen close-up environment for the interactive pixel-art app Flow Cabin. Use reference 1 ONLY for the cabin's architectural materials and lighting (honey oak, walnut beams, warm cream plaster, a quiet blue forest sunset) and reference 2 ONLY for the exact furniture character design (muted forest-green enamel/upholstery, brass fittings, pale honey wood, crafted realistic cozy pixel-art texture). Make a NEW camera shot, NOT a crop or enlarged isometric floor map and NOT an asset sheet. Camera is seated at a desk / slightly above sitting eye level, gentle three-quarter perspective with mostly front-facing objects that can be clicked. Full-bleed opaque landscape 1536×1024 image, every pixel filled by the interior; NO transparent exterior, no black vignette border, no cutaway silhouette. Premium deliberate crisp square pixel clusters, consistent pixel density, soft believable contact shadows, warm diffused natural light, no photorealistic rendering, no blurred UI. It should feel like entering one intimate usable corner of the same home. Clear single visual focus with only 3–5 functional objects, generous quiet space, no wall collage. NO human, NO pet/animal, NO text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermark, UI panels, selection frames, floating controls, menus or buttons. All pages, record covers, clocks and screens must remain completely BLANK so the actual app can place readable live content. Physical hardware knobs are okay, but no fake app controls. Objects must sit naturally on their supporting surface with readable contact and no overlap hiding their main face.

MUSIC CORNER. A beautiful large open-lid wood and deep-green record player is the hero, centered slightly left in the foreground on a warm wooden console, its black vinyl disc and brass tonearm clearly visible. The turntable occupies roughly x440–1050,y430–850 and has a large readable top plane; blank cream center label on the record. A low record cabinet at the far left holds only four upright sleeves; their front covers are plain cream/muted terracotta/muted green rectangles with NO artwork, words or markings, leaving faces for actual album covers in the app. A single beautifully crafted compact wooden speaker rests farther back on the right, unobscured. A large open lyrics notebook with two BLANK cream pages sits on the near right corner of the console, angled only slightly so live lyrics can be overlaid. These four objects are the entire functional composition. A single generous recessed window in the upper left background shows the warm pine hills from reference 1; upper-right plaster wall is mostly quiet and unadorned. Cropped console legs can be visible at the bottom, but no expansive floor. Focus on the record player; nearby book and cabinet remain secondary, no extra props, headphones, plants, lamps, picture frames, cups, clocks, fireplace or clutter. Physical room fills the screen, like the user's eye has moved to the listening desk.
